# QUIC packet fixtures

The `.hex` files contain the complete 1200-byte protected client Initial packet
from Appendix A.2 of RFC 9001 (QUIC v1) and RFC 9369 (QUIC v2). Both carry SNI
`example.com`. They are public protocol test vectors, not captured user traffic.

- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9001.html#name-client-initial
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9369.html#name-client-initial
